rule: Applied to the model's own input frame (raw columns plus the features the champion engineers). Rule: the 20 numeric columns with the highest univariate AUC against the target (de-duplicated: a column is skipped when it correlates above 0.9 with one already chosen), the four loan-size fundamentals every lender watches, the champion's financial ratios (debt-to-income and friends), and the 5 categorical columns most associated with the target (Cramer's V). Everything else is still measured (see `drift_table`) but kept out of the HTML report so it stays readable.
